classification.difficultyReason: Build base-6 digit products, then adapt positional multiplication and addition to carrying in groups of six, using the constructed table.

content.prompt: Complete a base 6 multiplication table. Use this to evaluate:

inlines.text: All entries are in base 6. Multiplication by 0 gives 0.

answer.worked: Multiply the row and column digits and write each product in base 6. For a decimal product $n=6q+r$, write the digits $q,r$. For example, $2\times3=6_{10}=10_6$, $4\times4=16_{10}=24_6$ and $5\times5=25_{10}=41_6$. Multiplication by 0 gives 0.

Use the base 6 table and carry in groups of six.
$$\begin{align*}32_6\times4_6&=212_6\\32_6\times10_6&=320_6\\32_6\times14_6&=212_6+320_6\\32_6\times14_6&=532_6\end{align*}$$
